insert_generation: snprintf per SQL included in sql_insert_s
data_distribution: sequential automatic ID; unique k equals ID; constant name
cache: warm process/OS cache; no OS cache eviction; not a cold-cache claim
storage_format: fixed-width little-endian binary slots; immutable CSV baseline retained for initial import/recovery
durability: normal WAL/binary fsync policy; 10000 explicit insertion transaction(s), up to 1 row(s) per transaction; durable ID ranges; UPDATE and DELETE each autocommit
batch_mode: explicit BEGIN/COMMIT per batch; size 1 uses the autocommit durable commit path but also parses BEGIN and COMMIT SQL
timing_notes: SQL insertion, BEGIN and COMMIT times are cumulative across batches; insert_phase_wall_s includes all three and loop overhead; commit includes snapshot preparation, WAL, changed binary slots and engine index maintenance; storage byte counters exclude WAL and filesystem write amplification; reopen includes full baseline/WAL replay and index construction; standalone BPT times exclude storage and compare shuffle construction; max is not p99
